messages:
Maya (CSM): Hey team — quick heads up: Helios Labs' procurement just pinged me for exact SLA/SLO language before signing. They asked about uptime, latency targets (especially for embeddings), and the credit math. Can we align on numbers I can hand them today?
Aj (SRE): Short version: hosted SLA = 99.9% monthly uptime for paid plans. For inference p95 targets — text-gen default path ~200ms, embeddings path ~120ms. Credits follow our standard outage-proration formula.
Samir (Infra): We should confirm region. Helios is EU-only for data residency; routing adds ~30–50ms p95 variance. If they use Dedicated, numbers are tighter.
Olivia (PM): Note: fallback policies (model variant fallback) can change observed latency; we need to call that out so customers understand seen variance during incidents.
Quentin (AE): Procurement will want a single-slide summary and a sample clause. Maya, can you deliver a one-pager? I can push on timeline if we give them firm numbers.
Maya (CSM): I can draft the one-pager. I need the legal-friendly phrasing for credits and a quick bullet for regional variance. If someone posts the exact credit calc I’ll slot it in.
Aj (SRE): Credit calc (simplified snippet):
```
if monthly_uptime < SLA_threshold:
  credit_pct = min( (SLA_threshold - monthly_uptime) * 100, 100 )
  credit = credit_pct * monthly_invoice
else:
  credit = 0
```
Use the formal table in the SLO playbook for the exact bands, but above is the simple explanation for procurement.
Samir (Infra): For EU hosted endpoints: median add = ~25ms; p95 add = ~45ms for embeddings when cross-region routing occurs. For Dedicated in eu-west-1 it's effectively +5–10ms.
Olivia (PM): I'll approve the wording on fallback and variance. Add this sentence: "Observed latency may vary by region and configured model variant; we provide regional performance baselines on request."
Quentin (AE): Also add contact matrix for escalations (CSM -> SRE -> Account Exec). Procurement will ask for names.
Maya (CSM): Draft checklist for my one-pager: 1) SLA uptime number + link to full SLA doc 2) p95 latency targets (text / embeddings) with regional note 3) credit calculation example 4) escalation contacts + on-call 5) optional: dedicated capacity note. Anyone want to take a bullet?
Aj (SRE): I'll drop the link to the SLA doc and a short blurb about how credits are computed from monitoring windows.
Samir (Infra): I'll produce a regional latency appendix (2 bullets) and a quick table comparing Hosted vs Dedicated p95s.
Olivia (PM): I'll sign off on final wording and add the fallback sentence.
Quentin (AE): I'll prep a procurement-friendly clause sample (one paragraph) and send to Maya.
Maya (CSM): Great — target: internal draft by EOD, final to customer tomorrow morning. I'll ping procurement when we have the one-pager. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: SLO reference doc updated: /docs/slo-playbook#quick-reference (revision 2026-03-21)
Maya (CSM): Thanks all — ping me here if anything changes.
Quentin (AE): +1, thanks.
Aj (SRE): quick note — if they request higher p95 guarantees for embeddings we should propose Dedicated + reserved routing. Saves back-and-forth.
Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll include a line: "Higher performance guarantees available via Dedicated capacity (contact AE)."
Samir (Infra): FYI: I'll upload the latency table to the shared drive and post link here when done.
Maya (CSM): Perfect — closing loop after draft.
